title: Can someone Test my game and give opinion?
author: Extreme_Economist914
selftext: Good Day Yall , like some of you the I've been wanting to make a game for my whole life, but until recently due to my lack of coding knowledge or artistic ability this was merely a dream. Until Astra and Opus 5.5 suddenly this dream is here within a few days I was able to make a Paperboy like game featuring my block and my real neighbors in the game. I sent the game around to my friends/neighbors and they were like wtf HOW?! It was a funny inside joke between us neighbors I Vibe coded it and it actually opened my eyes it wasn't that bad but the lessons learned from it I couldn't wait to start with a fresh idea and blank slate. Growing up in the 90's with the Sega Genesis and SNES I've always wanted to make something that felt like it was torn out of that era with some modern twists. Golden Axe was a huge game for me as a kid and I love that style game and also felt it would be a more accomplishable art style than lets say vibe coding GTA 7 right out of the get go LOL. Incomes my new game Bloody Axe,(working title) funny enough the whole game and its 6 levels are programed and I yet to have an Axe in the game so the name probably is changing i think to Oath keepers.  My Goal for the game in the end of development is to have a good looking , SUPER GORY, fun to play , responsive ,MOBA influenced characters with different specializations , an accessible character skill tree to level up character, and actually deliver a decent revenge story cliche as it may be. Ive been working on this game for hours a day for a few months , im enjoying working on it it does not feel like a chore to me. I make some changes then play the game then make some more changes and play the game over and over. My assessment is the game is about 40 percent done with 6 levels laid out, a basic story frame that still needs refinement , I would say the first level in the game is the most polished at 90 percent done. I will go level by level after completing development of level one applying the same workflow and logic as i did with the first level , just keep playing it and adding to it like a painting adding stroke by stroke until it just feels right. But at this point I see the path to completion and Its a matter of when not if. My real point of this post is im looking for someone who can play test the game and give me feedback, because after playing it 1000s of times I need a different set of eyes. Right now it plays on pc with controller, so you have to have that. I still need to figure out what to do with the music in the game because full transparency what's there now is merely a place card taken from other games to give me a feel while playing the game. The only thing in this game that is not completely made by me and the AI is the music. The final game will have its own music Im looking to partner with someone on like soundcloud to get the music made, im still not there yet. So is anyone out there hopefully with some retro game knowledge who would want to play the game and give me some pointers, and impressions? Keep in mind the games in alpha state, but like I said the Main character Rurik and the first level is basically complete, theres two other characters who are 70 percent complete and still playable, but i would most like to hear your experience with Rurik and the first level.

comments.author: CandlewellGames
comments.body: lol “no axe yet” made me laugh. Oath Keepers sounds better anyway. For music, r/gamedevclassifieds has a lot of composers, some of them do rev-share or free work for portfolio. Also maybe a TL;DR next time, I almost needed a save point halfway through lol

replies.author: Extreme_Economist914
replies.body: Thanks for the Pointer thats awesome ! To summarize im looking for some people to play the game and give me feedback!

replies.author: CandlewellGames
replies.body: Now that’s a TL;DR lol. I don’t have a controller on PC sadly, but r/playmygame and r/DestroyMyGame are made exactly for this, you’ll get honest feedback there.

comments.body: Hey, I'd be glad to test your game out and give you a review. Shoot me a dm.
